label: Strict co-reference of partial names: CoRef a b v means there exists a candidate bearer x…
definition: CoRef a b v means there exists a candidate bearer x designated by both a and b at v. Under RigidAt this is a common existing denotation. Empty names do not satisfy CoRef, even if their designation relations are extensionally equal. Box quantifies CoRef over the selected relation.
note: This explicit strict sentence convention separates reference from equality of names or reflexivity of bearer equality. It is an analyst convention, not a claim that Kripke universally endorses this treatment of empty names.
